items.title: Steel Nutcracker and Walnut Kernels
items.alt: Steel nutcracker with two textured black handles holding a walnut beside a bowl of kernels.
items.description: Serrated steel jaws surround a walnut between two open black grips. A small wooden bowl of kernels sits below the tool, keeping the kitchen still life compact and clear.

items.title: Wooden Nutcracker Press with a Shell Drawer
items.alt: Maple-colored nutcracker press with a dark wooden screw, wide turning bar and open shell drawer.
items.description: A dark threaded screw descends through the pale wooden frame toward a walnut. The small drawer below is pulled open to reveal a collection of broken shells.

items.title: Opening a Nutcracker Gift
items.alt: Curly-haired girl in glasses and a mustard dress holding a red nutcracker beside an open green gift box.
items.description: The girl sits cross-legged in striped tights, supporting the toy's base with one hand. A red ribbon spills from the open green box beside her brown lace-up shoes.

items.title: Repairing a Wooden Nutcracker
items.alt: Silver-haired woman working on a blue nutcracker held in a cradle on a wooden repair bench.
items.description: The toymaker bends over a blue wooden nutcracker resting securely in a padded cradle. A loose lever, small mallet and upright tool holder share the sturdy workbench.

items.title: Painting a Queen Nutcracker
items.alt: Seated man in a teal sweater and burgundy apron painting a purple-and-cream queen nutcracker.
items.description: A fine brush touches the queen toy's purple skirt while the painter steadies its base. Paint jars, a marked cloth and the small wooden table complete the workshop scene.

items.title: Ballet Dancer Holding a Nutcracker
items.alt: Ballet dancer in a navy leotard and ochre wrap skirt holding a green wooden nutcracker.
items.description: The dancer looks down at a small crowned nutcracker held close to her chest. Her ochre wrap skirt, crossed legs and soft ballet shoes form a narrow, balanced silhouette.
